mapper.sql: pk_id, id, tenant_id, people_id, source, goal_type, rate_kg_per_week, activity_level, disease_key, basis_weight_kg, basis_height_cm, basis_age, basis_gender, bmr_kcal, tdee_kcal, energy_kcal, carb_g, protein_g, fat_g, fiber_g, sodium_mg, meal_split_json, floor_applied, set_by_staff_id, note, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_goal( id, tenant_id, people_id, source, goal_type, rate_kg_per_week, activity_level, disease_key, basis_weight_kg, basis_height_cm, basis_age, basis_gender, bmr_kcal, tdee_kcal, energy_kcal, carb_g, protein_g, fat_g, fiber_g, sodium_mg, meal_split_json, floor_applied, set_by_staff_id, note, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{peopleId}, #{source}, #{goalType}, #{rateKgPerWeek}, #{activityLevel}, #{diseaseKey}, #{basisWeightKg}, #{basisHeightCm}, #{basisAge}, #{basisGender}, #{bmrKcal}, #{tdeeKcal}, #{energyKcal}, #{carbG}, #{proteinG}, #{fatG}, #{fiberG}, #{sodiumMg}, #{mealSplitJson}, #{floorApplied}, #{setByStaffId}, #{note}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_goal SET is_deleted = 1, gmt_deleted = NOW(), gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM diet_goal WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY gmt_created DESC LIMIT 1
